description: SP ENW - Operational Data - Live Total System Demand is a dataset listed in Electricity North West open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution network operator, published or maintained by Electricity North West. Dataset Classification - Open SP ENW - Operational Data - Live Total System Demand Updated every 15 minutes, this tabular dataset details the historic total system demand on the SP ENW network. This data is the summed demand across all 132kV Grid Supply Point feeds into the SP ENW Network. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Operational Data. Its keywords are Demand, Total System, Live. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-enw-open-data-portal.
